body: 美國航空業者預期2026年感恩節連假疏運近2900萬人次，返程人潮最為集中。航空運輸協會（Airlines for America）預期11月29日與30日為自11月20日起的11天疏運期中最繁忙的兩天，美國業者每日平均座位數較去年感恩節增加3.8萬個。
美國航空11月29日排定7021個航班，為疫情以來最繁忙的一天；11月19日至12月1日期間，美國航空與區域夥伴預期疏運逾800萬人次、近8.5萬個航班，航班數較去年感恩節增加4%，11月29日中午同時在空中的美國航空航班預期達1130架。聯合航空同一13天期間預期疏運逾660萬人次，11月20日星期五預期逾54萬人次，11月29日當天約60萬人次。

去年感恩節的安檢數字顯示返程人潮規模：2025年11月30日運輸安全管理局（TSA）安檢逾313萬人次，為TSA史上最繁忙的一天，約為感恩節當天156萬人次的兩倍，12月1日另有近290萬人次通過安檢；感恩節前後七天，洛杉磯國際機場（LAX）安檢約68.9萬人次居全美之冠，其次為紐約甘迺迪國際機場（JFK）64.7萬人次、亞特蘭大（ATL）60.3萬人次與芝加哥歐海爾（ORD）59.8萬人次。訂房平台Hopper統計，11月29日返程的美國國內來回機票均價為604美元，較一年中較不繁忙時段明顯偏高。

body: US airlines expect to carry nearly 29 million passengers over the 2026 Thanksgiving travel weekend, with the biggest crowds due as travelers head home from family celebrations. Airlines for America expects November 29 and 30 to be the two busiest days of the 11-day period that begins November 20, and US carriers are offering an average of 38,000 more seats per day than they did over Thanksgiving last year.

American Airlines has scheduled 7,021 flights for November 29, its busiest day since the pandemic. American and its regional partners expect more than 8 million passengers across nearly 85,000 flights between November 19 and December 1, with 4% more flights than last Thanksgiving, and at midday on November 29 American expects to have 1,130 flights in the air at once. United Airlines expects to carry more than 6.6 million passengers over the same 13 days, forecasts more than 540,000 passengers on Friday, November 20, and expects about 600,000 passengers on November 29.

Last year's screening figures show the scale of the return rush. The Sunday after Thanksgiving in 2025 was the busiest day the Transportation Security Administration (TSA) had ever recorded: TSA screened more than 3.13 million people at US airports on November 30, more than twice the 1.56 million who passed through checkpoints on Thanksgiving Day, and nearly 2.9 million more passed through security on December 1. Los Angeles International (LAX) handled the most checkpoint traffic during the seven days around Thanksgiving last year, with about 689,000 people, followed by 647,000 at New York's John F. Kennedy International (JFK), 603,000 at Atlanta (ATL) and 598,000 at Chicago O'Hare (ORD). Booking platform Hopper put the average domestic round-trip fare for travelers returning November 29 at $604, a hefty premium over the same flights at less busy times of the year.

zh.title: 菲律賓航空確定訂購15架波音787-10 另有5架購買權
zh.summary: 菲律賓航空敲定15架波音787-10訂單，並取得另5架購買權。
body: 菲律賓航空與波音及GE Aerospace簽署合約，確定訂購15架波音787-10客機，並取得另5架的購買權。合約最多涵蓋20架客機。
合約涵蓋客機及其GEnx-1B發動機，於2026年11月10日簽署；菲律賓航空於11月15日公佈這些合約。
這項訂單將2026年7月於Farnborough International Airshow首次公佈的採購承諾轉為確定訂單。客機預定在下個十年交付，航空公司未提供更精確的時程。

en.title: Philippine Airlines confirms order for 15 Boeing 787-10s, with rights for five more
en.summary: Philippine Airlines finalized an order for 15 Boeing 787-10s, with purchase rights for five more.
body: Philippine Airlines has signed contracts with Boeing and GE Aerospace for 15 firm Boeing 787-10 aircraft, with purchase rights for five more. The agreements cover up to 20 aircraft in total.
The agreements cover the aircraft and their GEnx-1B engines and were signed on November 10, 2026. Philippine Airlines announced the agreements on November 15.

The order converts a commitment first announced at the Farnborough International Airshow in July 2026 into a confirmed order. Deliveries are scheduled for the next decade, although the airline did not provide a more precise timeline.

zh.title: 達美航空砍波音767航線 北美業者擴增新線
zh.summary: 達美航空取消12條波音767航線；加拿大航空、西南航空與聯合航空開闢新航線。
body: 達美航空（Delta Air Lines）調整旗下國內航線佈局，決定取消12條使用波音（Boeing）767客機執飛的航線。該公司在國內短途航線上採取窄體客機轉型策略，受影響的航線包含亞特蘭大至底特律，以及紐約至拉斯維加斯等航線。
與此同時，北美多家航空公司持續擴展網絡。加拿大航空（Air Canada）規劃於四週內，自加拿大境內9座機場陸續推出22條新國際航線。西南航空（Southwest Airlines）則在單日內開闢5條新航線，趕在感恩節假期前上線運作。
聯合航空（United Airlines）亦同步推動航線擴增，於9天內推出6條新直飛航線，其中多數為短途國際服務，並包含一條長途航線。此外，聯合航空也針對從主要樞紐機場出發的7條國內航線，將航班班次翻倍增加。

en.title: Delta Cancels 767 Routes as North American Carriers Expand
en.summary: Delta Air Lines cuts 12 Boeing 767 routes; Air Canada, Southwest, and United Airlines launch new services.
body: Delta Air Lines is modifying its domestic network by canceling 12 routes operated by Boeing 767 aircraft. The carrier is shifting toward narrowbody aircraft on domestic short-haul services, affecting key routes including Atlanta to Detroit and New York to Las Vegas.

Meanwhile, other North American carriers are expanding their flight schedules. Air Canada is launching 22 new international routes taking off from nine airports across Canada within a four-week period. Southwest Airlines is introducing five new routes in a single day, timed for launch ahead of Thanksgiving.

United Airlines is also expanding operations, adding six new nonstop routes in nine days. Most of these additions are short-haul international services, alongside one long-haul route. Furthermore, United Airlines is doubling flights on seven domestic routes departing from a major hub.
